description: Block until a delivery completes or fails. Call this immediately after deliver_audience or deliver_file_match when the response has status: "processing". Polls GET /v1/audiences/{audience_id}/deliveries/{delivery_id} every 15 seconds. On success returns the full delivery object including download_urls[] — share these directly with the user. Each signed link is valid for 24 hours; expires_at is the delivery artifact retention date, not the link expiry. Call get_delivery for a fresh link while the artifact remains available. Throws DELIVERY_FAILED if the export failed (check failure_reason), or DELIVERY_TIMEOUT if it did not finish within timeout_seconds (default 30 seconds). A wait timeout does not cancel or fail the job; use the corresponding get tool to check it again. Requires 'discovery' scope.

audience_id.description: Audience ID returned by the delivery or file-match job; do not assume it equals match_id or segment_id

delivery_id.description: Delivery ID returned by deliver_audience or deliver_file_match

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait (default 30). Prefer get_delivery for a single status check; a wait timeout is not an export failure.

name: wait_for_delivery

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

download_urls.description: Fresh signed artifact URLs on an individual completed download delivery

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

title: Wait For Delivery
